package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for likely_unindexed_query: Query shapes like leading-wildcard LIKE or ORDER BY without LIMIT that often scale poorly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

type Product struct {
	ID          int
	Description string
}

func SearchProducts(db *sql.DB, keyword string) ([]Product, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query(
		"SELECT id, description FROM products WHERE description LIKE $1",
		"%"+keyword+"%",
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("search: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var products []Product
	for rows.Next() {
		var p Product
		rows.Scan(&p.ID, &p.Description)
		products = append(products, p)
	}
	return products, rows.Err()
}
